es: Reconocer have + objeto + participio para servicios pagados y para cosas malas que te pasan.

title.en: Have it done or make them do it
title.es: Have it done, get it done y make/let

es: Formar have/get + cosa + participio y have, get, make y let + persona para encargar, conseguir, obligar y permitir.

teaching.en: We are getting the kitchen painted this weekend.
teaching.es: Este fin de semana vamos a hacer pintar la cocina.
teaching.explanationEs: Get + objeto + participio equivale a have + objeto + participio, pero es más informal.
teaching.audioText: We are getting the kitchen painted this weekend.

teaching.en: Mia got the plumber to fix the sink yesterday.
teaching.es: Mia consiguió que el fontanero arreglara el fregadero ayer.
teaching.explanationEs: Get + persona + to + verbo: consigues que alguien lo haga.
teaching.audioText: Mia got the plumber to fix the sink yesterday.

teaching.en: Tom had the electrician check the lights.
teaching.es: Tom encargó al electricista que revisara las luces.
teaching.explanationEs: Have + persona + verbo base (sin to): encargar un trabajo.
teaching.audioText: Tom had the electrician check the lights.

teaching.en: Her mother will make her tidy her room every Friday.
teaching.es: Su madre la hará ordenar su cuarto cada viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Make + persona + verbo base: obligar, la persona no elige.
teaching.audioText: Her mother will make her tidy her room every Friday.

teaching.en: My parents let me choose the colour of my room.
teaching.es: Mis padres me dejan elegir el color de mi cuarto.
teaching.explanationEs: Let + persona + verbo base: permitir. Let no cambia en pasado.
teaching.audioText: My parents let me choose the colour of my room.

teaching.en: I want to get my bike fixed before Friday.
teaching.es: Quiero que me arreglen la bici antes del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Get + objeto + participio también funciona detrás de want to.
teaching.audioText: I want to get my bike fixed before Friday.

feedback.es: Hacer pintar un trabajo se dice have/get + objeto + participio: the kitchen painted.

The teacher got Mia wait outside.
The teacher made Mia wait outside.

hint.es: Obligar es más fuerte que permitir: Mia no decide.

hint.es: Después de la persona, el verbo lleva to.

feedback.es: Dejar salir es permitir: let + persona + verbo base, sin to.

origin.text: My parents ___ me go out on Saturdays.

feedback.es: Tom made his brother wash the car: make obliga. Jugar fue lo que le dejaron hacer después.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada estructura con su sentido.

choices.text: To wear a coat in the rain.
To stay at home when it rains.

feedback.es: La madre deja elegir la ropa con let, pero con make obliga a llevar abrigo cuando llueve.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cuenta lo que hizo Sara según el texto?

choices.text: Sara got the electrician come on Friday.
Sara made the electrician to come on Friday.
Sara got the electrician to come on Friday.

feedback.es: Sara consiguió que el electricista acudiera: get + persona + to + verbo. Sin to, o con made to, la frase es incorrecta.

answer.text: The plumber made us wait all morning

feedback.es: Make obliga y lleva verbo base: made us wait, sin to.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hicimos limpiar las ventanas la semana pasada.»

feedback.es: Encargar la limpieza de las ventanas es had + objeto + participio: the windows cleaned.

origin.text: We had the windows ___ last week.

choices.text: My sister let me use her bike.
My sister made me use her bike.
My sister got me use her bike.

feedback.es: Let me use her bike expresa permiso: let + persona + verbo base. Made sería obligar y got me use es incorrecto.

feedback.es: El dentista le hace una revisión con have, y con made le obliga a cuidar sus dientes dos veces al día.

title.es: Citas en la peluquería y en el taller

es: Entender llamadas breves para encargar un servicio e identificar qué se encarga, el plazo y la condición.

teaching.en: Mia has an appointment to have her hair cut and dyed on Thursday.
teaching.es: Mia tiene cita para cortarse y teñirse el pelo el jueves.
teaching.explanationEs: Appointment es una cita para un servicio. Have her hair cut and dyed: dos participios, dos trabajos.
segments: Mia has an appointment to have her
hair cut and dyed on Thursday.
teaching.audioText: Mia has an appointment to have her hair cut and dyed on Thursday.

teaching.audioText: The garage can have the brakes checked by Friday.

teaching.en: The deadline is Friday, but only if the parts arrive on Wednesday.

if the parts arrive on Wednesday.

segments: Tom is having his phone screen replaced

es: Escribir un plan de reforma que reparta lo que haces tú, lo que encargas a otros y las reglas de la casa con make y let.

teaching.en: For the makeover, we will paint the walls ourselves.

teaching.audioText: We will have the shelves installed by a carpenter.

es: Reclamar una reparación defectuosa: decir qué encargaste, describir el defecto, pedir una solución y confirmar el nuevo plazo.

teaching.en: I am calling to make a complaint about a repair.

teaching.audioText: I am calling to make a complaint about a repair.

teaching.en: I had my laptop repaired on Monday, but it still does not work properly.

teaching.audioText: The part is faulty, so I would like a refund or a free repair.

teaching.en: We apologise, and we promise to have it ready by Thursday.
teaching.es: Pedimos disculpas y prometemos tenerlo listo para el jueves.
teaching.explanationEs: Promise to + verbo base. La tienda confirma el nuevo plazo con by.
segments: We apologise, and we promise to
teaching.audioText: We apologise, and we promise to have it ready by Thursday.

teaching.en: Can you have it repaired again by Friday?
teaching.es: ¿Pueden hacer que lo reparen otra vez para el viernes, a más tardar?
teaching.explanationEs: Again = otra vez. Can you have it + participio pide que se repita el trabajo.
teaching.audioText: Can you have it repaired again by Friday?

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase dice que Carlos encargó la reparación a la tienda?

choices.text: I repaired my bike on Monday.
I had repaired my bike on Monday.
I had my bike repaired on Monday.

feedback.es: Had my bike repaired significa que la tienda hizo el trabajo. Repaired sola diría que Carlos la reparó él mismo.

hint.es: Quien encarga un trabajo usa had + objeto + participio.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hice reparar mi móvil el lunes, pero todavía no funciona bien.»

feedback.es: Still indica que el problema continúa pese a la reparación. Va antes de does not work.

hint.es: Es la palabra que dice que el defecto continúa.

origin.text: I had my phone repaired on Monday, but it ___ does not work properly.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Quisiera un reembolso, por favor.»

answer.text: I would like a refund please

feedback.es: Would like es la fórmula educada para pedir una solución: I would like a refund.

hint.es: Empieza con la fórmula cortés para pedir.

prompt.es: Elige cómo pedir que lo reparen otra vez antes del viernes.

choices.text: Can you have it repaired again by Friday?
Can you have repaired it again by Friday?
Can you have it repair again by Friday?

feedback.es: Can you have it repaired again by Friday? lleva have + objeto + participio. Las otras opciones cambian el orden o usan el verbo base.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué defecto denuncia el cliente.

choices.text: The laptop does not turn on.
The screen has marks on it.

feedback.es: El cliente dice que la pantalla está scratched: tiene marcas o rayones. La reparación del portátil ya estaba hecha.

origin.audio: Hello, I had my laptop repaired on Monday, but the screen is scratched. I would like a free repair.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase de la queja con su paso.

pairs: I had my watch repaired last week.
It still does not work properly.
Can you have it ready by Friday?

feedback.es: Una reclamación ordena el encargo, el defecto, la solución y el nuevo plazo.

pairs: I had my watch repaired last week.
It still does not work properly.
Can you have it ready by Friday?

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué promete el taller.

choices.text: The garage will pay for a new car.
The lights will work without any repair.
Someone will come to check the lights this week.

feedback.es: El taller promete enviar a un electricista antes del miércoles para revisar las luces del coche.

origin.audio: I had my car serviced last week, but the lights still do not work. The garage promises to send an electrician by Wednesday.

prompt.es: ¿Qué pide el cliente en el mensaje?

choices.text: Money back, or another cleaning for free.
A new suit from the shop.
Only to talk to the manager.

feedback.es: El cliente pide el reembolso o una segunda limpieza gratis: I would like a refund or a free cleaning.

origin.text: Hello manager, I had my suit cleaned on Friday, but it is still dirty. I would like a refund or a free cleaning by Monday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Mi madre siempre me obliga a llamar a la tienda.»

feedback.es: Obligar se dice con make + persona + verbo base. Con my mother, el presente es makes.

origin.text: My mother always ___ me call the shop.

prompt.es: Escribe una reclamación: lo encargado, el defecto, una petición y el plazo.

answer.text: Hello, I am calling to make a complaint about a repair. I had my washing machine repaired last week, but it still does not work properly and the door is scratched. The repair was not cheap, so I would like a refund or a free repair, please. Can you have it ready by Friday?
accepted: Hello, I am calling to make a complaint about a repair. I had my washing machine repaired last week, but it still does not work properly and the door is scratched. The repair was not cheap, so I would like a refund or a free repair, please. Can you have it ready by Friday?

Good morning. I had my washing machine repaired at your shop last week, but it still does not work properly. The door is also scratched. I would like my money back, or can you have it repaired again by Friday?

feedback.es: Una reclamación clara dice qué encargaste (had … repaired), el defecto con still, una petición educada y un plazo con by.

origin.text: Caso: hace una semana hiciste reparar tu lavadora en un taller. Sigue sin funcionar bien y la puerta quedó rayada. Reclama: di qué encargaste, describe el defecto, pide un reembolso o una reparación gratis y confirma el plazo (el viernes).

prompt.es: Elige la frase que cuenta una experiencia mala de Carlos en la estación.

choices.text: Carlos had his phone repaired at the station.
Carlos had his phone stolen at the station.
Carlos made his phone stolen at the station.

feedback.es: Had his phone stolen cuenta algo que le ocurrió a Carlos sin quererlo. La otra frase habla de un servicio pagado.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la condición para tener la bolsa lista el jueves.

feedback.es: La condición es only if you bring it today: hay que dejar la bolsa en la tienda hoy mismo.

origin.audio: The shop promises to have your bag fixed by Thursday, but only if you bring it today.

prompt.es: Escribe una frase con make o let sobre una regla de tu casa.

answer.text: My parents make me tidy my room every Saturday.
accepted: My parents make me tidy my room every Saturday.
My father makes me tidy up my room on Saturdays.
My parents make me tidy my room on Saturday.

feedback.es: La regla con make dice qué obligan a hacer: make + persona + verbo base. Tidy va sin to.

origin.text: Regla: tus padres te obligan a ordenar tu cuarto cada sábado.
